tools.name: ynab_get_transactions
tools.description: Gets transactions from a plan, optionally between a start and end date and by type (all, uncategorized or unapproved). Filter by at most one of account, category or payee: they cannot be combined, and if several are given only the first in that order is applied. To search, add payee or memo text, an amount range or a direction. Any search option (or untilDate) adds inflow, outflow and net totals over every match; the totals include transfers between accounts, such as credit card payments. totalsOnly returns just the totals (e.g. categoryId with a year's dates and totalsOnly). Without categoryId or payeeId, split transactions are matched leg by leg and the totals count only the matching legs. With categoryId or payeeId, rows are matched as YNAB returns them, so a split's parent row in the payee listing counts at its full amount.

tools.name: ynab_balance_forecast
tools.description: Projects the combined balance of your accounts over the next N days (from today in UTC) from scheduled transactions only: the starting balance, the scheduled events, the end-of-day running balance and the lowest point. Income or spending that is not scheduled in YNAB is not in the forecast. Transfers between two included accounts (credit card payments too) net to zero; a transfer to an account outside the forecast counts as money leaving, and one from an account outside it as money arriving. Split schedules are counted leg by leg. Occurrences whose date has passed but that YNAB has not entered yet count on the first day, marked overdue with their scheduled_date and summarised in overdue_schedules. Where YNAB does not give the second date of a twice-a-month schedule, it is approximated as 15 days after the first. Events are capped by limit; the running balance, low point and ending balance always cover every day. For past income versus spending, use ynab_cash_flow; to list the schedules themselves, use ynab_list_scheduled_transactions.

tools.name: ynab_detect_recurring
tools.description: Finds recurring outflows (subscriptions, bills, memberships) in transaction history by payee, similar amount and regular spacing, whether or not they are scheduled in YNAB. For the scheduled transactions set up in YNAB, use ynab_list_scheduled_transactions. Gives each one's cadence, typical amount, yearly cost at the latest amount, next expected date, whether it seems to have stopped, and already_scheduled (a scheduled transaction has the same payee name; amounts are not compared). This is a heuristic: check the results before acting on them. Splits are counted through their subtransactions. Transfers are excluded, so loan and mortgage payments (transfers to a loan account) and credit card payments are not reported. Inflows are excluded too, and refunds are not netted against charges. Reads the whole window from YNAB in one request, which is slow for a long sinceDate on a busy plan. Yearly charges need a sinceDate far enough back to show minOccurrences of them.
